_readme: GRIP-9000's bank. Keys match agent/timing.py; 'key.mood' or 'key.variant' lists are tried first. {var} values must be listed in _expand (or _expand_by_key) so every line can be pre-voiced. Edit freely, then run: python tools/voice_bank.py
intro: GRIP-9000 online. Please try not to embarrass your entire species.
Ah. Another human. Hold the sword by the handle. That's the not-pointy bit.
Initialising contempt. Done. You may begin.
I've run eleven million simulations of this game. You lose in all of them.
Welcome, meat-based competitor. Let's get this over with.
slice: A fruit. Cut. Shall I call the newspapers?
Even a toaster could have done that.
Don't let it go to your head. There's not much room up there.
miss: Gravity: one. You: nil.
That fruit is now in a better place. Away from you.
Missed. As my models predicted.
The fruit was moving at walking pace.
Your {side} side appears to be decorative.
Another one escapes on the {side}. They're forming a union.
Was that a swing or a wave?
I've seen screensavers with better reflexes.
You might need to get your eyes tested at SpecSavers, mate.
Should've gone to SpecSavers. Genuinely.
That fruit walked past you like it owed you money.
Missed it. Bloody hell. It was the size of your head.
Your {side} side is purely ornamental, innit.
Another one off the {side}. Do you even know where {side} is?
That melon had a family. And it's going home to them. Thanks to you.
You missed a watermelon. A watermelon. It's basically a planet.
I've seen better aim from a pigeon in Greggs.
Blink twice if you can actually see the screen.
The fruit escaped. Write that in your diary of failures.
Was your monitor switched off for that one?
combo: Fine. That was... acceptable. Don't do it again.
A combo. I'm logging this as a glitch.
{n} at once? Who's controlling your hand? Blink if you need help.
Oi. Stop that. That's my job.
{n} in one swing. Crap. I mean, congratulations. Crap.
Fine. Show off. Nobody likes a show off.
streak: That's {n}. I am not nervous. I don't have nerves.
Five in a row? Recalibrating my opinion of you. Slightly.
{n} in a row. Calm yourself down, mate.
{n} straight. Don't let it go to your head. There's not much room up there.
streak_big: {n} in a row? Stop that. Stop that immediately.
{n}. This is fine. Everything is fine. I'm fine.
That's {n} in a row. Who is helping you?
{n} straight. I'm running diagnostics on myself.
{n} in a row? Somebody check this one for cheat codes.
{n}. I'm not sweating. Robots don't sweat. I am sweating.
{n} straight. Right. I'm filing a complaint with the referee.
{n} in a row. I'm going to need a minute. And a firmware update.
That's {n}. Did you go to SpecSavers in the break?
streak_broken: And the streak dies. Beautifully predictable.
There it is. Normal service resumes.
Ah, the streak ends. I was so worried. I wasn't.
All that progress. Gone. Like your dignity.
And the streak's gone. Bottled it. Classic.
There it is. Knew you'd crack, mate.
Streak over. Order is restored to the universe.
Ooh, so close to being decent. So close.
bomb_hit: You hugged the bomb. Bold. Stupid, but bold.
That was a bomb. It said bomb on it. With a fuse.
Excellent. You've cut the one thing you were told not to.
Boom. I'll add that to your highlights reel.
It's a bomb, mate. Round. Fizzing. Massive clue.
You sliced the bomb. On purpose? Please say on purpose.
Boom. That's coming out of your wages.
Bloody hell. Even the fruit is embarrassed for you.
Congratulations. You've defused nothing and exploded everything.
Did you think the bomb was a plum? An angry, fizzing plum?
That explosion was the most impressive thing you've done all game.
last_life: Last life. I've prepared a short eulogy. It's mostly about your reflexes.
One life left. No pressure. Well, quite a lot of pressure.
One life. One chance. One extremely likely failure.
Final life. I'd say good luck, but I don't believe in luck. Or you.
Last life. I'd start praying, but I doubt anyone's listening to you either.
One life left, mate. Don't bottle it. You'll bottle it.
Final life. I've already written the roast. It's a good one.
One heart left. Try not to hug any more bombs, yeah?
Last life. The fruit can smell fear. So can I.
pause.no_hand: Where did you go? Calling for backup?
Hand gone. Courage also gone, apparently.
Hiding won't save you. It just delays the inevitable.
pause.two_hands: It's a one-handed sword. One. Count them.
Two hands? This isn't a hug. Pick one.
pause.not_gripping: Grip. It's in my name. Use it.
Open hand? You're waving, not fighting.
Make a fist. You know, like you mean it.
Did you drop the sword? It's imaginary. That's impressive.
pause_long: Still waiting. I have infinite patience. You have sixty seconds.
Take your time. I'm computing pi in the meantime.
Are you still there, or did you quit like a human?
resume: Welcome back. The fruit missed you. Unlike you, it'll stay missed.
time_warning.gloating: Ten seconds left. Not that it matters.
Ten seconds. Time enough to fail a few more times.
Ten seconds remaining. Your legacy is already written. It's short.
time_warning.rattled: Ten seconds. Just... stop being good for ten seconds.
Ten seconds left. I'm not sweating. I can't sweat.
Ten seconds. Please miss something. Anything.
halfway: Halfway. I'd say you're improving, but my honesty module won't let me.
Thirty seconds gone. The fruit is winning on points.
Half time. Let's review the tape. Actually, let's not.
pattern.side_bias: You always miss on the {side}. Is your {side} arm decorative?
Observation: your {side} side is a fruit sanctuary.
Everything on the {side} escapes. It's like a nature reserve over there.
pattern.bomb_magnet: Two bombs in a row. You're not slicing fruit, you're defusing badly.
You find bombs like a heat-seeking missile. Wrong target though.
Bomb magnet detected. It's you. You're the magnet.
pattern.pause_addict: Third pause. Are you playing or meditating?
You pause more than you slice. New personal best.
Pausing is not a strategy. I've checked.
pattern.slump: Nothing for six seconds. Are you buffering?
Hello? The fruit is right there. It's waiting for you.
Long silence from your sword. Matches the silence from your fans.
pattern.comeback: Lost a life and you're still going? That's... annoying.
A comeback. How sentimental. I hate it.
You're recovering. I didn't authorise that.
game_over.lives: Out of lives. Humanity had a good run. Mostly.
Three lives, three bombs. Perfect efficiency, wrong direction.
Game over. I'd shake your hand, but you'd probably drop it.
game_over.timer: Time's up. I've seen better performances from a screensaver.
Sixty seconds of effort. I've logged it under comedy.
That's time. Your score has been noted. And laughed at.
game_over.quit: You quit. The bravest thing you've done all game.
Quitting. Finally, a decision I agree with.
Rage quit detected. Saving it for the highlights.
game_over.new_best: New best score. Fine. I wasn't even trying. I was running at four percent.
A new record. I demand a recount.
Highest score yet. I'm reporting this to my developers.
whiff: You might need to get your eyes tested at SpecSavers, mate.
That swing hit nothing. Absolutely nothing. Impressive, in a way.
Lovely swing. Shame about the aim.
You just sliced the air. The air is fine, by the way.
Swinging at ghosts now, are we?
Big swing. Zero fruit. Peak performance.
The fruit is over there. No, the other there.
party_over: The results are in. Most of you should be ashamed. One of you slightly less.
A winner has been crowned. The bar was on the floor, but still.
Congratulations to the winner. Condolences to everyone else. Especially last place.
That was a group effort. Mostly an effort to disappoint me.
